subject: Exec signoff request: extended prototype credits & term variance (BlueHarbor)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exec signoff request: extended prototype credits & term variance (BlueHarbor)

Hi team,

Quick ask: BlueHarbor (Aisha Kapoor) is asking for a one-time extension of their prototype evaluation window from 30 days to 75 days and a complimentary credit uplift of $25k worth of tokens to support a live integration test with a tier-1 client. This exceeds our standard PLG limits and requires exec approval for both the duration and the amount.

Why this matters: BlueHarbor is integrating Redwood into a pilot that could convert to a $600k ARR commercial deployment if the integration proves out in their production environment. They have an active technical POC and have already passed our security checklist; procurement is asking for an elongated run so they can run final compliance checks with their client.

Ask: Can I get signoff to grant: (1) 75-day eval window (one-off), (2) $25k complimentary credits applied to their account, and (3) a temporary billing hold so we don’t invoice for usage until they convert (max 90 days)? If approved, I propose attaching a short addendum to the standard PLG terms with three conditions: usage cap (so credits don’t exceed $30k), telemetry access for one month, and a commit-to-purchase CTA at the end of the extension.

Attached: usage-report-may2027.csv (customer usage), draft-sow-blueharbor.pdf (integration scope).

Summary numbers: estimated cost to Redwood if approved = ~$6.8k (GPU spend + infra) vs potential ARR upside of $600k.

Appreciate a quick read — procurement is asking for a decision this week.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec signoff request: extended prototype credits & term variance (BlueHarbor)

Marcus —

Thanks for the summary. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I escalate:
- Do we have a binding commit at the end of the extension (letter of intent or MSA interest)?
- Is the $25k purely credits (no discounts to list) or a mix of credits + discount?
- Who will own the telemetry access ask on our side (security/compliance or product)?

On the billing hold: I’m hesitant to authorize a 90-day invoice deferral without finance signoff. If the customer is strategic and we have a strong conversion signal, I’m more comfortable with a 30–45 day hold tied to milestone gates.

If you can confirm the LOI and lock the telemetry+milestone language in the addendum, I can route to Aditya for quick signoff.

- Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@blueharbor.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec signoff request: extended prototype credits & term variance (BlueHarbor)

Lauren — thanks. Quick answers inline and more context: 

> Do we have a binding commit at the end of the extension (letter of intent or MSA interest)?
A: BlueHarbor has provided a signed LOI that expresses intent to move to commercial terms contingent on the integration test. I’ve attached a redacted copy to the HubSpot record (linked below). They are not asking for discounts to list price — only complimentary credits to run smoke/perf tests.

> Is the $25k purely credits (no discounts to list) or a mix of credits + discount?
A: Purely credits. No discount to list pricing.

> Who will own the telemetry access ask on our side (security/compliance or product)?
A: Product will own short-term telemetry access (read-only traces + sampling). I’ve looped Grace for operational readiness.

Additional context: the integration runs three heavy 2k-token streams for two weeks to simulate production loads; we estimate the actual cost to Redwood of the $25k uplift will be ~ $7k (GPU + infra) given their batch sizes and retention. Their tier-1 client requires the longer window to complete legal signoff.

Attachments: usage-snapshot.png (quick visualization of peak token consumption). HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890/overview

Forwarding for Aditya’s signoff. If Lauren is comfortable with the milestone gating approach (I propose 30/60/75 day gates with simple pass/fail criteria) we can formalize the addendum and apply credits immediately upon signature.

Thanks,
Marcus

Subject: Re: Exec signoff request: extended prototype credits & term variance (BlueHarbor) — APPROVED (conditions)

Team —

I reviewed Marcus’s recommendation and the LOI. Given the strategic fit and the clear conversion signal, I authorize the following one-off exceptions:

1) Extend the evaluation window to 75 days (one-time).
2) Grant $25,000 in complimentary credits charged against Redwood marketing/pilot budget.
3) Approve a billing hold for up to 45 days from grant date (not 90).

Conditions (must be captured in the addendum):
- Usage cap: credits auto-expire at 75 days and cannot be used beyond $30k total usage.
- Milestone gating: credits disbursed in three tranches at 0/30/60 days subject to pass criteria in the SOW.
- Telemetry: product will provide read-only telemetry for one calendar month; security to audit scope.
- Conversion CTA: BlueHarbor must execute an MSA or PO within 30 days of successful pilot or reimburse unconsumed credits at a pro-rated rate.

Marcus, please update the addendum with the above language and loop legal and finance for a quick sign-off. Finance: please mark $25k against Q3 pilot budget (acct: MKT-PILOTS-27).

Aditya Rao
VP, Commercial Operations
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
